record.question: Who was the running mate of Kamala Harris in the 2024 U.S. Presidential election?
record.explanation: Answer C: Tim Walz. Tim Walz was the Democratic vice-presidential nominee alongside Kamala Harris in 2024. Reference: https://www.democrats.org/news/vice-president-kamala-harris-announces-governor-tim-walz-as-running-mate. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
